name: webperf-core-web-vitals
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, VS Code extensions and other Agent Skills agents
short: Your agent measures LCP, CLS and INP with tested scripts and picks the next check from the result.
what: The skill gives your agent seven fixed JavaScript snippets for Core Web Vitals: LCP, CLS and INP, plus LCP subparts, the LCP trail, LCP image entropy and LCP video candidates. The agent runs them and reads the result object they return, so it doesn't write measuring code on the fly. Workflows cover a full audit, an LCP deep dive, a CLS investigation and INP debugging, and the next snippet depends on what the last one found.
who: Web developers who want their agent to find out why a page is slow and point at the cause. If you only want a score now and then, the snippets also run by hand in the DevTools console.
needs: A coding agent that supports Agent Skills
Chrome DevTools MCP, so the agent can run the snippets in your browser
Or, without it: the webperf-snippets CLI with Playwright and Chromium

steps.title: Install the skills
steps.text: This installs all six webperf skills into `~/.claude/skills/`, including this one.

steps.title: Or install from a clone
steps.text: Use `npm run install-skills` for the current project only, or `npm run install-global` for every project.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/nucliweb/webperf-snippets.git
cd webperf-snippets
npm run install-skills

steps.title: Connect Chrome DevTools MCP
steps.text: With it, the agent runs each snippet in your browser and reads what it returns.

steps.title: Or use the CLI instead
steps.text: Install it with `npm install --save-dev webperf-snippets playwright`, then `npx playwright install chromium`. It loads the page in headless Chromium.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Audit this page for Core Web Vitals

watch: With Chrome DevTools MCP, the agent runs JavaScript in your browser, including on pages where you are signed in.
Some steps in the CLS and INP workflows point to snippets in the webperf-interaction skill, which the skill marks as pending.
The snippets are tested in Chrome. Most also work in other Chromium browsers and Firefox, and Safari has limited support.
